reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage BUSD programs through paid levels, partner invitations, and matrix positions tied to rewards. It presents rapid, substantial participant outcomes and specific matrix-cycle yields while recommending activation of multiple levels. Although it says results depend on participant actions and denies that Forsage is an investment program, the described promotion and reward structure show a recruitment-based participation mechanism.

citations.quote: allows you to receive instant rewards in BUSD directly to your own crypto wallet
Many participants have achieved amazing financial result, changing their whole lives in the first 3-8 weeks of getting started with Forsage and some even became dollar millionaires.
When you register with Forsage, the first levels of X3 and X4 programs that costs 5 BUSD each are activated.

When you invite partners, they register in your structure and fill out the spots in your Matrix. The distribution of rewards is done automatically and instantly by the smart contract when your partners fill out the spots in your matrix .
Accordingly, 100% from Recycle is transferred to your upLINE.

opening.argument: The presentation expressly rejects the framing of a passive investment and tells viewers that outcomes depend on what they do. That is a meaningful qualification: it does not promise that simply joining produces returns, and it directs viewers toward participation and learning rather than guaranteeing an outcome. The claimed benefits therefore remain conditional promotional language, not a stated assurance of profit.

citations.quote: Forsage is not an investment program. Results should not be expected to come by themselves. Results will come from your actions
If you are unsure of how to act, use the Forsage Academy knowledge available to participants.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited rewards and participant stories do not erase the explicit qualification that results do not come by themselves. Describing possible outcomes, while separately stating that results depend on user action, is materially different from guaranteeing them. The recommendation to learn through the Academy also supports a conditional, participant-driven presentation rather than a promise of automatic wealth.

citations.quote: Results should not be expected to come by themselves. Results will come from your actions
Forsage was created for you, for your development, for your success

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclaimer is outweighed by the mechanism the presentation actually promotes: users pay for levels, invite partners, and receive stated rewards when partners fill matrix positions. Saying results require action does not make that recruitment-linked structure ordinary or non-deceptive, especially alongside claims of life-changing results.

citations.quote: When you register with Forsage, the first levels of X3 and X4 programs that costs 5 BUSD each are activated.
When you invite partners, they register in your structure and fill out the spots in your Matrix.
Many participants have achieved amazing financial result, changing their whole lives in the first 3-8 weeks of getting started with Forsage and some even became dollar millionaires.

opening.argument: The video can reasonably be understood as an operational overview of how a blockchain platform works. It identifies the particular programs covered, explains their structure and levels, and describes how a smart contract distributes transactions. The emphasis is on teaching viewers the mechanics of Forsage BUSD, not on presenting a personal guarantee or certifying that every projected result will occur.

citations.quote: In this particular video, we will focus only on Forsage marketing programs based on BUSD stablecoin and how they work.
Blockchain with revolutionary smart contract technology executes the Forsage programs automatically in a decentralized way.
There are four programs to be available in Farsash BUS, X3, X4, XXX and XGold.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material an overview does not change what the overview teaches. It explains paid registration, partner placement, and rewards, while also urging viewers to start at several levels for better results. That is operational instruction for joining and advancing in the program, not neutral technical education.

citations.quote: When you register with Forsage, the first levels of X3 and X4 programs that costs 5 BUSD each are activated.
it's recommended to activate at least the first three levels in each program at the start this ensures good initial results

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The content may explain mechanics, but the mechanics are the promotional substance: paid levels and matrix positions generate rewards from later participants. A tutorial format cannot neutralize the direct invitation to participate or the stated financial outcomes attached to that participation.

citations.quote: When you invite partners, they register in your structure and fill out the spots in your Matrix.
The Total yield from one xxx Matrix cycle is $680.
The fastest and furious results are obtained by those who start from many levels at once

opening.argument: The presentation describes a branded blockchain-based marketing program with defined levels, participant structures, and automated transfers. Its claim is not that money appears without activity: it says users must act, invite partners, and work within the presented programs. The material also says the creators do not centrally hold members' cryptocurrency and that transactions can be checked online, which supports a transparent promotional service rather than an alleged hidden-custody scheme.

citations.quote: the creators of Forsage never take or store members' cryptocurrencies in any centralized location. So it is completely secure!
You can easily verify all of the transactions online on the blockchain as the platform is fully transparent.
Results should not be expected to come by themselves. Results will come from your actions

rebuttal.rebuttal: Transparency of transactions is not the disputed issue. The presentation still requires paid levels and connects rewards to partners filling matrix spots, including transfers to an upline. Calling the arrangement a marketing program does not make those recruitment-linked payments comparable to ordinary discounts or loyalty rewards.

citations.quote: When you invite partners, they register in your structure and fill out the spots in your Matrix.
Accordingly, 100% from Recycle is transferred to your upLINE.
the first levels of X3 and X4 programs that costs 5 BUSD each are activated.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of centralized custody does not answer whether the promoted income depends on recruitment. The evidence expressly describes paid entry, partner placement, matrix recycling, and upline transfers. Those are not merely ordinary promotional points or cashback; they are the core financial mechanism being presented.
